'''Snowblind''' was the name of a giant [[Pantran whitefang]] living on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] until [[3642 BBY]], when it was [[Death/Legends|killed]] on the [[Snowblind's Hunting Grounds|its hunting grounds]] in the [[Crystal Wastes]].

==Behind the scenes==
Snowblind appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Hoth. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
